findings.claim: The chapter derives 23.3 days from 118.8 over 5.1 and then adds twenty-three, so the same quantity is stated two ways in one passage, though the rounded day is unchanged either way.
findings.fix: Carry the decimal, or say explicitly that it is being rounded.
findings.reference: bible/world.md, ## Rules — the ninety-day derivation bullet
findings.note: Upheld as accurate but not actioned: science scored 9, above the threshold of 8, and DO NOT TOUCH outranks improving a passing characteristic. The critic itself notes the final date is the same on either figure.
